out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. EHS EXPLAINED THAT SHELLSTOCK TAGS MUST BE DATED AND KEPT FOR 90 DAYS.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. OBSERVED BUILD UP ON THE INTERIOR OF THE ICE MACHINE
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided

violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the front of the kitchen being used to dump drinks. EHS observed, residual drinks, ice and limes in the hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC CLEANED OUT THE HAND SINK.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: rice 111F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED RICE TO 165F.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: soup and cooked meat in the walk in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC ADDED DATE.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the bar is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT HANDWASHING SINKS MUST BE ACCESSIBLE TO ALL EMPLOYEES AT ALL TIMES. NO ITEMS SHALL BE STORED IN ANY HANDWASHING SINKS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: prepared masa dough being stored next to raw chicken in the 3DR prep top unit.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS RTE FOODS ARE TO BE STORE ABOVE RAW PROTEINS. PREPARED MASA WAS MOVED TO THE TOP SHELF OF THE 3DR PREP TOP UNIT.

out_items.name: Proper disposition of returned, previously served, reconditioned and unsafe food

violations.title: Discarding Unsafe/Adulterated/Not Honestly Presented Food
violations.observation: The following food item(s) is unsafe, adulterated, or not honestly presented and shall be discarded or reconditioned: Orange juice stored in a milk jug at the bar.
violations.corrective_action: A food that is unsafe, adulterated, or not honestly presented shall be discarded or reconditioned according to an approved procedure. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT MILK JUGS SHALL NOT BE REUSED TO STORE ORANGE JUICE DUE TO CROSS CONTAMINATION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: black beans and rice in the Wells hot holding unit along the prep line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS EXPLAINED HOT FOODS NEED TO BE HELD AT 135f OR HIGHER. PIC INCREASED THE TEMPERATURE OF THE UNIT.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: multiple items seen in the walk in and prep cooler did not have date marking.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC UNDERSTANDS FOOD ITEMS NEED TO BE DATE MARKED IF BEING HELD FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: EHS observed multiple bulk bins storing items that are difficult to identify to the left of the stove.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT ALL ITEMS TAKEN OUT OF ITS ORIGINAL CONTAINER NEEDS TO BE LABELED. PIC WILL FIX BY NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. EHS observed canned goods stored directly on the floor in the bar area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. VIVA TEQUILA III RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 01/08/2025) Page 2 of 3
